import pandas as pd

# Create the dataframe from the provided table
data = {
    'Date': ['Feb 2–5, Feb 11', 'May 21–22, Jun 11', 'Jul 18, Jul 25', 'Sep 16', 'Sep 19', 'Sep 28', 'Oct 9', 'Oct 9, Oct 11', 'Oct 1, Oct 15', 'Oct 17, Oct 20', 'Oct 23', 'Nov 11', 'Nov 12, Nov 18', 'Nov 16–18'],
    'Festival': ['Santa Barbara International Film Festival', 'Seattle International Film Festival', 'Fantasia Festival', 'Athens International Film Festival', 'Lund International Fantastic Film Festival', 'Fantastic Fest', 'London Int. Festival of Science Fiction Film', 'Sitges Film Festival', 'Gwacheon International SF Festival', 'Icon TLV', 'Toronto After Dark', 'Les Utopiales', 'Indonesia Fantastic Film Festival', 'AFF'],
    'Location': ['Santa Barbara, California  USA', 'Seattle, Washington  USA', 'Montreal, Quebec  Canada', 'Athens, Attica\n Greece', 'Lund, Skåne\n Sweden', 'Austin, Texas\n USA', 'London, England\n UK', 'Sitges, Catalonia\n Spain', 'Gwacheon, Gyeonggi-do\n South Korea', 'Tel Aviv, Central\n Israel', 'Toronto, Ontario\n Canada', 'Nantes, Pays de la Loire\n France', 'Jakarta, Bandung\n Indonesia', 'Wrocław, Lower Silesia\n Poland'],
    'Awards': ['Top 11 "Best of the Fest" Selection', '', 'Special Mention\n"for the resourcefulness and unwavering determination by a director to realize his unique vision"', 'Best Director', '', '', 'Closing Night Film', '', '', '', 'Best Special Effects\nBest Musical Score', '', '', ''],
    'Link': ['sbiff.org', 'siff.net', 'FanTasia', 'aiff.gr', 'fff.se', 'FantasticFest.com', 'Sci-Fi London', 'Sitges Festival', 'gisf.org', 'icon.org.il', 'torontoafterdark.com', 'utopiales.org', 'inaff.com', 'AFF Poland']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert the 'Date' column to a datetime-like format for sorting, using the first date in the range
def extract_first_date(date_str):
    # Split by commas and take the first part, then split by '–' or '-' and take the first part
    first_part = date_str.split(',')[0]
    # Remove any leading/trailing spaces
    first_part = first_part.strip()
    # Split by range indicators
    if '–' in first_part:
        first_date = first_part.split('–')[0]
    elif '-' in first_part:
        first_date = first_part.split('-')[0]
    else:
        first_date = first_part
    # Append a year (2011) to make it a full date
    return pd.to_datetime(first_date + ' 2011', format='%b %d %Y', errors='coerce')

df['FirstDate'] = df['Date'].apply(extract_first_date)

# Sort the dataframe by the extracted first date
df_sorted = df.sort_values('FirstDate')

# Find the index of the Fantasia Festival
fantasia_index = df_sorted[df_sorted['Festival'] == 'Fantasia Festival'].index[0]

# Get the festival immediately before Fantasia Festival
previous_festival = df_sorted.loc[df_sorted.index[fantasia_index - 1], 'Festival']

answer = previous_festival
